text.tspan: Bloom filter: k hashes into an m-bit array
Any bit = 0 -> definitely not present. All bits = 1 -> probably present (false positive possible).
m = -n ln(p) / (ln 2)^2 bits, k = (m/n) ln 2. ~10 bits per item gives ~1% false positives. No deletes (use counting variant).
